sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，尸体里的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手为了隐瞒她的身份费尽了心思。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她只被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查到了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 1942, at nine years old, Blanche Taylor Moore, born Blanche Kaiser, left the small town of Tar Heel, North Carolina, with her family,
sentences.zh: 1942年，九岁的布兰奇·泰勒·摩尔（原名布兰奇·凯泽）随家人离开了北卡罗来纳州塔尔希尔这个小镇，

sentences.en: in search of opportunity in the growing city of Burlington.
sentences.zh: 前往日益发展的伯灵顿市寻找机会。

sentences.en: Burlington had sprung almost a century before, when in the mid-1800s, it became a small village built around the office for the North Carolina Railroad,
sentences.zh: 伯灵顿几乎是在一个世纪前兴起的，当时在19世纪中叶，它只是围绕着北卡罗来纳铁路办公室建立的一个小村庄，

sentences.en: a small community of simple shops servicing the comings and goings of the train network.
sentences.zh: 是一个为铁路网络往来提供服务的小型社区，只有几家简单的商店。

sentences.en: By the 1900s, the rail officers had moved elsewhere, and Burlington, in order to prosper, moved with the times.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪，铁路部门搬到了别处，为了繁荣发展，伯灵顿也与时俱进。

sentences.en: Small textile mills opened up, and these factories drew more people to Burlington as work grew scarce through the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 小型纺织厂开了起来，随着大萧条时期工作机会变得稀缺，这些工厂吸引了更多人来到伯灵顿。

sentences.en: As the Second World War approached, the army started a military tank rebuilding program in Burlington,
sentences.zh: 随着第二次世界大战临近，军队在伯灵顿启动了一个军用坦克重建项目，

sentences.en: and the federal government purchased land to construct an aircraft factory where they built military planes.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府也购买了土地，建造了一家制造军用飞机的飞机工厂。

sentences.en: After the war, the company Western Electric arrived, adding electronics to the growing military industry.
sentences.zh: 战后，西部电气公司入驻，为日益增长的军事工业增添了电子设备制造业务。

sentences.en: They built radar equipment and guidance systems for missiles.
sentences.zh: 他们制造雷达设备和导弹制导系统。

sentences.en: With the addition of these new jobs, the years between 1940 and 1950 saw the city's population double from around 12,000 people to around 25,000 people.
sentences.zh: 随着这些新工作的增加，1940年到1950年间，该市人口翻了一番，从约1.2万人增加到约2.5万人。

sentences.en: Burlington had shown its ability to adapt and prosper through economic change.
sentences.zh: 伯灵顿展现了其在经济变革中适应和繁荣的能力。

sentences.en: Its people were hard workers, who battled on through the ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们勤劳刻苦，在起起落落中顽强拼搏。

sentences.en: Post-war, the flatland and rolling hills were dotted with large dairy, grain and tobacco farms, which would become a source of huge income for the area.
sentences.zh: 战后，平原和连绵的丘陵上点缀着大型乳制品、谷物和烟草农场，这成为了该地区巨大的收入来源。

sentences.en: Many families from outer areas moved to Burlington and neighbouring towns in search of work in the textile mills or on the farMs.
sentences.zh: 许多来自外围地区的家庭搬到伯灵顿及周边城镇，寻找在纺织厂或农场工作的机会。

sentences.en: That's exactly why the Kaiser family moved to Burlington.
sentences.zh: 这正是凯泽一家搬到伯灵顿的原因。

sentences.en: In search of opportunity.
sentences.zh: 为了寻找机会。

sentences.en: To start a new life.
sentences.zh: 为了开始新的生活。

sentences.en: Blanche Taylor Moore was born on February 17th, 1933.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇·泰勒·摩尔出生于1933年2月17日。

sentences.en: She was the fifth of seven children.
sentences.zh: 她是七个孩子中的第五个。

sentences.en: When the family arrived in Burlington in 1942, her parents, Parker Davis Kaiser and Flonnie Blanche Kaiser, both gained employment in the local mills.
sentences.zh: 1942年全家到达伯灵顿时，她的父母帕克·戴维斯·凯泽和弗洛妮·布兰奇·凯泽都在当地工厂找到了工作。

sentences.en: They were fairly poor, but so was everyone else in town.
sentences.zh: 他们相当贫穷，但镇上的其他人也一样。

sentences.en: The kids felt no different to anyone else who lived the same way they did, side by side in identical housing.
sentences.zh: 孩子们觉得他们和住在一起、住在同样房子里的其他人没什么不同。

sentences.en: When he wasn't working in the local sawmill, Blanche's father, Parker, was a self-taught minister, a gambler and an alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇的父亲帕克在不在当地锯木厂工作时，是个自学成才的牧师，还是个赌徒和酒鬼。

sentences.en: Blanche's mother, Flonnie, worked full-time in the mills as a yarn spinner, bringing home $40 per week.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇的母亲弗洛妮在工厂全职做纱线纺纱工，每周带回家40美元。

sentences.en: She handed over half of her salary to Parker, who she knew would go out and spend it on gambling and other women.
sentences.zh: 她把一半工资交给帕克，因为她知道他会拿去赌博和找别的女人。

sentences.en: Parker was strict and often abusive.
sentences.zh: 帕克为人严厉，经常施加虐待。

sentences.en: He didn't allow his children any life outside of the house apart from school and church.
sentences.zh: 除了上学和去教堂，他不允许孩子们有任何家庭以外的生活。

sentences.en: He often took to the pulpit at local churches and community meetings to preach in a style that he himself called primitive.
sentences.zh: 他经常在当地教堂和社区会议上走上讲坛，以一种他自称为“原始派”的风格布道。

sentences.en: His alcoholism had stemmed from the Great Depression, and it caused his family to fear him.
sentences.zh: 他的酗酒始于大萧条时期，这让他的家人对他感到恐惧。

sentences.en: He was known to be physically abusive, and there are also reports that he sexually abused his daughter, Blanche.
sentences.zh: 众所周知他有身体虐待行为，还有报道称他曾性虐待自己的女儿布兰奇。

sentences.en: On top of that, Parker began using Blanche as a means to gain money.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，帕克还开始利用布兰奇来赚钱。

sentences.en: From around the time Blanche turned nine, he sold her to older men so he could repay his gambling debts.
sentences.zh: 从布兰奇九岁左右开始，他就把她卖给年长的男人，以便偿还赌债。

sentences.en: He handed his own daughter over to pedophiles.
sentences.zh: 他把自己亲生女儿交给了恋童癖者。

sentences.en: This went on well into Blanche's teen years.
sentences.zh: 这种情况一直持续到布兰奇十几岁。

sentences.en: It's understood that her mother, Flonnie, knew what was going on, but didn't intervene.
sentences.zh: 据了解，她的母亲弗洛妮知道发生了什么，但并没有干预。

sentences.en: Blanche found solace in her Christian church.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇在基督教堂里找到了慰藉。

sentences.en: The gospel music gave her a sense of peace and comfort throughout her traumatic childhood.
sentences.zh: 福音音乐在她充满创伤的童年里给了她一种平静和安慰。

sentences.en: When Blanche was a teenager, she became aware that her father was living a double life.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇十几岁时，意识到父亲过着双重生活。

sentences.en: He had a completely separate family, with four other children.
sentences.zh: 他有一个完全独立的家庭，还有四个孩子。

sentences.en: Flonnie knew, but did nothing.
sentences.zh: 弗洛妮知道，但什么也没做。

sentences.en: There was no change to their family situation, and Parker remained in the house.
sentences.zh: 他们的家庭状况没有任何改变，帕克依然住在家里。

sentences.en: It didn't change much for Blanche.
sentences.zh: 这对布兰奇来说并没有什么改变。

sentences.en: She already resented her father.
sentences.zh: 她早就怨恨她的父亲了。

sentences.en: That seed of hate sprouted long before.
sentences.zh: 那颗仇恨的种子早在很久以前就种下了。

sentences.en: Blanche's escape from her abusive home came in 1952, when at age 19, she met and married 24-year-old James Napoleon Taylor.
sentences.zh: 1952年，19岁的布兰奇遇到了24岁的詹姆斯·拿破仑·泰勒并与他结婚，从而逃离了那个充满虐待的家。

sentences.en: James was a furniture maker and restorer by trade, and had just returned home after fighting in the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯以制作和修复家具为业，刚从朝鲜战争战场回到家乡。

sentences.en: He was stocky and had a short fuse.
sentences.zh: 他身材敦实，脾气火爆。

sentences.en: A trait Blanche knew well.
sentences.zh: 这是布兰奇非常熟悉的一种特质。

sentences.en: Blanche had a new lease on life after she married James.
sentences.zh: 嫁给詹姆斯后，布兰奇的生活焕然一新。

sentences.en: She was known for her outgoing personality, and was often described as the life of the party.
sentences.zh: 她以性格外向著称，常被形容为派对的灵魂人物。

sentences.en: She was also known to have a quirky side.
sentences.zh: 她也以古怪的一面而闻名。

sentences.en: She could go from quoting Bible scripture to talking about sexually explicit topics in the one conversation.
sentences.zh: 她可以在同一场谈话中从引用圣经经文转而谈论露骨的性话题。

sentences.en: The year after they married, 1953, their first daughter, Vanessa, was born.
sentences.zh: 婚后第二年，即1953年，他们的第一个女儿凡妮莎出生了。

sentences.en: It would be another five years before their second daughter, Cynthia, arrived.
sentences.zh: 又过了五年，他们的第二个女儿辛西娅才出生。

sentences.en: In October 1953, the supermarket chain Kroger's opened in Burlington.
sentences.zh: 1953年10月，克罗格超市连锁店在伯灵顿开业。

sentences.en: The late 1940s had seen the rise of consolidated grocery stores roll out across America,
sentences.zh: 20世纪40年代末，综合杂货店在全美范围内兴起，

sentences.en: and when Kroger's opened on South Church Street, it brought with it a new era of sophistication and prestige.
sentences.zh: 当克罗格超市在南教堂街开业时，它带来了一个新的精致和尊贵的时代。

sentences.en: It was the new way of shopping, where staff continued the friendly local feel of the old-fashioned grocery store, but on a much bigger scale.
sentences.zh: 这是一种新的购物方式，员工们延续了老式杂货店那种友好的地方感，但规模要大得多。

sentences.en: The new wave of supermarkets sat side-by-side to the bowling alleys and diners of the day.
sentences.zh: 新一波超市与当时的保龄球馆和餐馆并排而立。

sentences.en: Blanche began working at Kroger's as a cashier in 1954, age 21.
sentences.zh: 1954年，21岁的布兰奇开始在克罗格担任收银员。

sentences.en: With her long black hair and eyes so dark they almost seemed black,
sentences.zh: 她留着一头乌黑的长发，眼睛深邃得近乎黑色，

sentences.en: Blanche was well-known and well-liked, a church-going mother with a bright smile.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇很受欢迎，人缘很好，是一位笑容灿烂、经常去教堂的母亲。

sentences.en: She was energetic and had a fun side, despite her troubled younger years, and her home life, which was already starting to show cracks.
sentences.zh: 尽管有着坎坷的童年和已经开始出现裂痕的家庭生活，她依然充满活力，有着风趣的一面。

sentences.en: Her husband James had taken up the drink after the war, and much like Blanche's father Parker, he would disappear for sometimes weeks on end without explanation.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫詹姆斯在战后开始酗酒，就像布兰奇的父亲帕克一样，他有时会无缘无故地失踪几周。

sentences.en: James too was a gambler, and just as Blanche had witnessed her mother do years before, she also gave her husband part of her paycheck so he could pay off his gambling debts.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯也是个赌徒，就像布兰奇多年前目睹母亲所做的那样，她也把部分工资交给丈夫，让他偿还赌债。

sentences.en: In 1956, Blanche's father Parker left Flonnie and moved in with his other family.
sentences.zh: 1956年，布兰奇的父亲帕克离开了弗洛妮，搬去和他的另一个家庭住在一起。

sentences.en: It took Flonnie almost three years to file the divorce papers, on which she wrote Parker had left her to take up with the younger women.
sentences.zh: 弗洛妮花了近三年时间才提交离婚申请，她在上面写道，帕克离开她是去和年轻女人在一起了。

sentences.en: She didn't mention the second family, even though she knew that was the real reason he left.
sentences.zh: 她没有提到第二个家庭，尽管她知道那才是他离开的真正原因。

sentences.en: By 1959, Blanche had worked her way up to head cashier, which was the highest job possible for a female employee at Kroger's at the time.
sentences.zh: 到1959年，布兰奇已升任首席收银员，这是当时克罗格女性员工能获得的最高职位。

sentences.en: She had high self-esteem and flourished in her role.
sentences.zh: 她自尊心很强，在工作中如鱼得水。

sentences.en: She even had use of the company car, which was an unheard-of privilege at the time.
sentences.zh: 她甚至可以使用公司用车，这在当时是闻所未闻的特权。

sentences.en: Rumours started to circle that she was cheating on her husband James with a few of her co-workers, and even some customers, but Blanche denied them.
sentences.zh: 有传言称她背着丈夫詹姆斯与几位同事甚至一些顾客有染，但布兰奇予以否认。

sentences.en: She had just given birth to her second daughter Cynthia, and being a new mother and spending more time at home, she joined the Tupperware craze, which had boomed during the 50s.
sentences.zh: 她刚生下第二个女儿辛西娅，作为一名新手妈妈，她花更多时间待在家里，并加入了在50年代风靡一时的特百惠热潮。

sentences.en: Blanche put on Tupperware parties which enabled her to have a social life.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇举办特百惠派对，这让她有了社交生活。

sentences.en: And sometimes, Tupperware parties would become a cover story for when she was cheating on James.
sentences.zh: 有时，特百惠派对成了她背着詹姆斯偷情的掩护。

sentences.en: It turned out, the rumours were true.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，传言是真的。

sentences.en: Blanche and James' sex life had become non-existent.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇和詹姆斯的性生活已经名存实亡。

sentences.en: Blanche said his alcoholism, gambling and impotence carved a wedge in their marriage, which they would never recover from.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇说，他的酗酒、赌博和阳痿在他们的婚姻中划下了一道鸿沟，他们永远无法修复。

sentences.en: There were many physical altercations between them, and not all were behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 他们之间发生过多次肢体冲突，而且并非都在私下里进行。

sentences.en: On one occasion, James confronted Blanche in plain view of onlookers about having an affair with one of her customers.
sentences.zh: 有一次，詹姆斯在众目睽睽之下质问布兰奇与她的一位顾客有染。

sentences.en: And on another occasion, people looked on as James dragged Blanche behind their car during an argument.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，人们目睹詹姆斯在争吵中拖着布兰奇在车后走。

sentences.en: In 1962, Kroger's got a new assistant manager, 27-year-old Raymond Reed.
sentences.zh: 1962年，克罗格迎来了一位新的助理经理，27岁的雷蒙德·里德。

sentences.en: He was married with two boys.
sentences.zh: 他已婚，有两个儿子。

sentences.en: Blanche took an instant liking to Raymond and pursued him, never hiding her flirtations from anyone else, even though she was still married to James.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇立刻喜欢上了雷蒙德并对他展开追求，尽管她当时仍与詹姆斯维持着婚姻关系，但她从不掩饰自己的调情。

sentences.en: Eventually, after three years of persistence, Raymond fell for Blanche, and the two began an intense affair.
sentences.zh: 最终，在三年的坚持下，雷蒙德爱上了布兰奇，两人开始了激烈的婚外情。

sentences.en: In September 1966, Blanche decided to reconcile her relationship with her father Parker, who at age 62 was still with his second wife and four other children.
sentences.zh: 1966年9月，布兰奇决定与父亲帕克和解，当时62岁的帕克仍与他的第二任妻子和另外四个孩子生活在一起。

sentences.en: Blanche reconciled with him just in time, as his health quickly began deteriorating.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇与他及时和解了，因为他的健康状况很快开始恶化。

sentences.en: He became gravely ill.
sentences.zh: 他病得很重。

sentences.en: Blanche remained at his bedside and acted as his nurse throughout.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇一直守在他的床边，充当他的护士。

sentences.en: He became delirious and suffered excruciating pain with stomach cramps, diarrhoea and vomiting.
sentences.zh: 他变得神志不清，饱受胃痉挛、腹泻和呕吐的剧痛折磨。

sentences.en: A few weeks after becoming ill, he turned a shade of blue before suffering a heart attack, which killed him.
sentences.zh: 生病几周后，他脸色发青，随后心脏病发作去世了。

sentences.en: Blanche's husband, James Taylor, also suffered a heart attack around at this time.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇的丈夫詹姆斯·泰勒此时也心脏病发作了。

sentences.en: But he survived and actually turned his life around.
sentences.zh: 但他活了下来，而且实际上彻底改变了生活。

sentences.en: He gave up drinking and became heavily involved in the church.
sentences.zh: 他戒了酒，并积极参与教会活动。

sentences.en: He became focused on his family and spent more time with his daughters.
sentences.zh: 他开始专注于家庭，花更多时间陪伴女儿们。

sentences.en: His spare time was spent at the Glenhope Baptist Church, helping to edit recordings of the sermons to send overseas to missionary workers.
sentences.zh: 他把业余时间花在格伦霍普浸信会教堂，帮助编辑布道录音，寄给海外的传教士。

sentences.en: As he started to get his life back on track, his mother, Isla Taylor, became ill.
sentences.zh: 当他的生活开始步入正轨时，他的母亲艾拉·泰勒病倒了。

sentences.en: Although Blanche continued her long-running affair with her assistant manager, Raymond Reed, she remained at home as a mother to her children, a wife to James,
sentences.zh: 尽管布兰奇继续着与助理经理雷蒙德·里德的长期婚外情，但她仍留在家中，作为孩子们的母亲、詹姆斯的妻子，

sentences.en: and as a nurse to her mother-in-law, Isla, as her health deteriorated.
sentences.zh: 并在婆婆艾拉健康恶化时担任她的护士。

sentences.en: She nursed Isla when she became bedridden, just like she had nursed her sick father.
sentences.zh: 就像照顾生病的父亲一样，她在艾拉卧床不起时照顾她。

sentences.en: Blanche hadn't been that close to Isla, but in those months, she became the doting nursemaid.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇和艾拉并不亲近，但在那几个月里，她成了一名悉心照料的护工。

sentences.en: She cooked for Isla and often spoon-fed her elderly mother-in-law to give her strength, but it didn't help.
sentences.zh: 她为艾拉做饭，经常用勺子喂这位年迈的婆婆以增强她的体力，但这无济于事。

sentences.en: And Isla died shortly after.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，艾拉去世了。

sentences.en: In early 1971, after a five-year affair, Raymond found it impossible to keep hiding their relationship,
sentences.zh: 1971年初，在五年的婚外情后，雷蒙德发现无法再隐瞒他们的关系，

sentences.en: and he left his wife and family, but Blanche remained at home with James and her girls.
sentences.zh: 他离开了妻子和家庭，但布兰奇仍与詹姆斯和女儿们住在家里。

sentences.en: Raymond didn't mind.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德并不介意。

sentences.en: Neither he nor Blanche stayed faithful to each other during their affair.
sentences.zh: 在婚外情期间，他和布兰德对彼此都不忠。

sentences.en: The end of Raymond's first marriage became official in 1973, when he divorced his wife.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德的第一段婚姻在1973年正式结束，当时他与妻子离婚了。

sentences.en: In September of that year, James Taylor became ill.
sentences.zh: 那年9月，詹姆斯·泰勒病倒了。

sentences.en: He had debilitating flu-like symptoms and deteriorated quickly.
sentences.zh: 他出现了严重的流感样症状，病情迅速恶化。

sentences.en: He lost his hair and suffered bloody stools and urine.
sentences.zh: 他脱发，并出现血便和血尿。

sentences.en: He got painful blisters on his hands and feet, and by the time he was on his deathbed, he had such bad stomach issues that he could no longer eat the meals his wife Blanche had
sentences.zh: 他的手脚长出了痛苦的水泡，到他临终时，他的胃部问题非常严重，以至于无法再吃妻子布兰奇为他

sentences.en: carefully prepared for him.
sentences.zh: 精心准备的饭菜。

sentences.en: Blanche was experienced in nursing someone so ill.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇在护理重病患者方面经验丰富。

sentences.en: James was the third person on their deathbed she had cared for.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯是她照顾的第三个临终者。

sentences.en: She knew exactly what someone feeling so awful needed, and she brought him ice cream.
sentences.zh: 她非常清楚一个感觉如此糟糕的人需要什么，于是她拿来了冰淇淋。

sentences.en: She had to feed it to him because he was so weak.
sentences.zh: 因为他太虚弱了，她不得不喂他吃。

sentences.en: And only a few hours later, he took his last breath.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几个小时后，他就咽下了最后一口气。

sentences.en: It was October 2nd, 1971.
James was 45 years old.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯年仅45岁。

sentences.en: Blanche, a widow at 40, wasn't surprised when the doctor who came explained he had suffered a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 40岁的布兰奇成了寡妇，当医生解释说他死于心脏病时，她并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: She recognised the same blue tint to his face she had seen on her father before his death.
sentences.zh: 她认出了他脸上那种青色，那是她在父亲去世前曾见过的颜色。

sentences.en: James left her with little money.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯留给她的钱很少。

sentences.en: Even the small amount they had received after Isla died was gone, and there was barely enough cash to pay for his burial.
sentences.zh: 即使是艾拉去世后他们得到的那点钱也花光了，几乎连支付他葬礼费用的现金都不够。

sentences.en: But after selling their house, Blanche had enough to buy a better place in Burlington,
sentences.zh: 但在卖掉房子后，布兰奇有足够的钱在伯灵顿买了一处更好的住所，

sentences.en: and as she was officially widowed, there was no need to hide her relationship with Raymond Reed anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且由于她正式守寡，再也不需要隐瞒她与雷蒙德·里德的关系了。

sentences.en: According to Blanche's daughters of Vanessa and Cynthia, Raymond Reed was a good father figure and a good man.
sentences.zh: 据布兰奇的女儿凡妮莎和辛西娅说，雷蒙德·里德是个很好的父亲形象，也是个好人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Blanche had become notorious at Kroger's, not just because of her high-level position and rumoured dalliances,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，布兰奇在克罗格变得声名狼藉，不仅因为她身居高位和传闻中的风流韵事，

sentences.en: but she was always smartly dressed and had something about her that drew the men in and turned some women away.
sentences.zh: 还因为她总是穿着时髦，身上有一种吸引男人却让一些女人反感的气质。

sentences.en: She seemed to have the ability to flirt and frighten in the same look.
sentences.zh: 她似乎有一种能力，能用同一个眼神既调情又让人恐惧。

sentences.en: In the years 1979 and 1980, Raymond was transferred several times around the greater area.
sentences.zh: 1979年和1980年，雷蒙德在大区域内被多次调动。

sentences.en: Whether his and Blanche's relationship was the catalyst is unknown, but Raymond eventually settled on a position as the manager of a store in nearby Winston-Salem.
sentences.zh: 不知道他和布兰奇的关系是否是导火索，但雷蒙德最终在附近的温斯顿-塞勒姆的一家商店担任经理。

sentences.en: It was hot gossip amongst Kroger employees that Blanche had begun a relationship with Kroger's regional manager, Kevin Denton.
sentences.zh: 克罗格员工中流传着一个热门八卦，说布兰奇已经开始与克罗格的区域经理凯文·丹顿交往。

sentences.en: There was talk of others she was seeing as well.
sentences.zh: 还有传言说她也在和其他人来往。

sentences.en: By that time, she had lost her affection for Raymond.
sentences.zh: 到那时，她对雷蒙德的感情已经消失了。

sentences.en: She had been with him for over a decade, and after straying into the arms of her regional manager, Kevin, she got a taste for life beyond Raymond.
sentences.zh: 她和他在一起十多年了，在投入区域经理凯文的怀抱后，她尝到了雷蒙德之外的生活滋味。

sentences.en: On January 23rd, 1985, Blanche's home in Burlington burnt down.
sentences.zh: 1985年1月23日，布兰奇在伯灵顿的家被烧毁了。

sentences.en: When the fire brigade confirmed it was likely arson, she told them there had been a strange man loitering around her property.
sentences.zh: 当消防队确认这很可能是纵火时，她告诉他们有一个陌生男人一直在她房产附近徘徊。

sentences.en: She called him a pervert and insinuated he had been watching her.
sentences.zh: 她称他为变态，并暗示他一直在监视她。

sentences.en: The police were unable to identify him.
sentences.zh: 警方无法确定他的身份。

sentences.en: Blanche received an insurance check shortly after and purchased a trailer home nearby.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇不久后收到了一张保险支票，并在附近买了一辆拖车房。

sentences.en: A month later, that burnt down as well.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，那辆拖车房也被烧毁了。

sentences.en: She said it was the work of the same man as before, the pervert.
sentences.zh: 她说那是之前那个人的所作所为，那个变态。

sentences.en: She received another insurance check, but relied heavily on Raymond for financial support.
sentences.zh: 她又收到了一张保险支票，但经济上仍严重依赖雷蒙德的支持。

sentences.en: Despite her other relationships, Raymond was still in the picture, and he always looked after her.
sentences.zh: 尽管她还有其他关系，但雷蒙德始终在她的生活中，而且他一直照顾着她。

sentences.en: At age 52, Blanche was thought of by many as friendly and kind, and by most men's accounts, she was very attractive.
sentences.zh: 52岁那年，布兰奇在许多人眼中既友好又善良，而在大多数男人看来，她非常有魅力。

sentences.en: She seemed to always have someone interested in her.
sentences.zh: 她似乎总能吸引到别人对她产生兴趣。

sentences.en: Her love life so far had been a long stretch of men, often one in current favour, and someone else either fading in or fading out.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，她的感情生活经历了一长串的男人，通常有一个正得宠的，而另一个人则在淡入或淡出。

sentences.en: She was still seeing Raymond, and if gossip was to be believed, she was still seeing her regional manager Kevin Denton as well.
sentences.zh: 她当时还在和雷蒙德交往，如果流言可信的话，她同时也还在和她的区域经理凯文·丹顿来往。

sentences.en: But she didn't want to be tied down with either of them.
sentences.zh: 但她不想被他们中的任何一个束缚住。

sentences.en: Blanche had been very involved in church her whole life, but she was said to have lost her faith after the fires.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇一生都非常热衷于教会活动，但据说在火灾之后，她失去了信仰。

sentences.en: That didn't last long though.
sentences.zh: 不过那并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: Just two months later, on Easter Sunday, Blanche went with a relative to the Sunrise Service at the Carolina United Church of ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 仅仅两个月后，在复活节那天，布兰奇随一位亲戚去了卡罗莱纳基督联合教会参加晨曦礼拜。

sentences.en: The small, quiet community church was just outside Burlington, and was one she had never attended before.
sentences.zh: 那是一座位于伯灵顿郊外的小型安静社区教堂，她以前从未去过。

sentences.en: The service was delivered by a handsome, recently divorced pastor, the Reverend Dwight Moore.
sentences.zh: 礼拜由一位英俊、刚离婚不久的牧师德怀特·摩尔主持。

sentences.en: Dwight had two children, and was very popular within his community.
sentences.zh: 德怀特有两个孩子，在社区里非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: He noticed Blanche in the congregation, and at the conclusion of the service, Blanche introduced herself to the Reverend.
sentences.zh: 他注意到了会众中的布兰奇，礼拜结束后，布兰奇主动向牧师做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: Blanche left having made a strong impression on him.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇离开时给他留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: She started visiting him regularly at the church, and they began meeting for meals.
sentences.zh: 她开始定期去教堂看他，他们也开始一起吃饭。

sentences.en: Reverend Moore would call Blanche often, and stop by her house unannounced.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师经常给布兰奇打电话，还会不请自来地去她家。

sentences.en: If she wasn't home, he would leave cards on her doorstep.
sentences.zh: 如果她不在家，他就会在她的门阶上留下卡片。

sentences.en: Blanche enjoyed the courtship, but said they were never physical during this time.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇很享受这段求爱过程，但她说在此期间他们从未有过身体接触。

sentences.en: The Reverend never hid his affections, but Blanche kept him at a distance.
sentences.zh: 牧师从不掩饰自己的爱意，但布兰奇一直与他保持距离。

sentences.en: She was interested, but she didn't want anyone else to know.
sentences.zh: 她对他有兴趣，但不想让别人知道。

sentences.en: One of Reverend Moore's letters, written on his personal stationery, was a page filled with the word Blanche.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师写的一封信，用的是他的个人信笺，整整一页纸上写满了“布兰奇”这个词。

sentences.en: He had handwritten her name over fifty times, before finishing off with the following message.
sentences.zh: 他手写了她的名字五十多次，最后写下了以下信息。

sentences.en: You are, without question, the most caring, giving, thoughtful, considerate, tender-hearted, loving, selfless, responsible, charitable, benevolent, merciful, patient, just,
sentences.zh: 你毫无疑问是我所认识的最关心他人、乐于奉献、体贴入微、善解人意、温柔善良、充满爱心、无私奉献、负责任、乐善好施、仁慈宽厚、宽容忍耐、公正、

sentences.en: virtuous, faithful, sincere, trustworthy, and decent person I have ever known.
sentences.zh: 品德高尚、忠诚可靠、真诚坦率、值得信赖且正派的人。

sentences.en: You are also quite attractive, and I like you.
sentences.zh: 你也非常有魅力，我很喜欢你。

sentences.en: By this time, Blanche had worked at Kroger's for over thirty years.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，布兰奇已经在克罗格超市工作了三十多年。

sentences.en: Everyone in the community knew her by name, and many admired her.
sentences.zh: 社区里的每个人都叫得出她的名字，许多人都很钦佩她。

sentences.en: Many customers picked her checkout line just so they could chat to her.
sentences.zh: 很多顾客专门排她的结账通道，就为了能和她聊聊天。

sentences.en: But something was going on behind the scenes at Kroger's.
sentences.zh: 但克罗格超市的幕后却发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: Not everyone who worked with Blanche liked her.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有和布兰奇一起工作的人都喜欢她。

sentences.en: They felt there was another, more disingenuous side to her.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得她还有另一面，更虚伪的一面。

sentences.en: Some called her vindictive and two-faced.
sentences.zh: 有些人称她为怀恨在心且两面三刀的人。

sentences.en: The affairs with other staff members and customers were also becoming a problem.
sentences.zh: 她与其他员工和顾客的私情也开始成为一个问题。

sentences.en: It wasn't as secretive as Blanche would have liked.
sentences.zh: 这并不像布兰奇希望的那样隐秘。

sentences.en: In October 1985, Blanche went to work an evening shift at Kroger's.
sentences.zh: 1985年10月，布兰奇去克罗格超市上晚班。

sentences.en: During her shift, she was called upstairs for a chat by Roger J.
sentences.zh: 轮班期间，她被罗杰·J叫到楼上谈话。

sentences.en: Hutton, the Mid-Atlantic Marketing Area Zone Manager.
sentences.zh: 赫顿，大西洋中部营销区域经理。

sentences.en: Blanche said that Hutton grabbed her from behind when she walked into the room, and he was naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇说，当她走进房间时，赫顿从背后抓住了她，而且他腰部以下赤身裸体。

sentences.en: He said to Blanche,
sentences.zh: 他对布兰奇说：

sentences.en: Blanche, are you ready for this?
sentences.zh: 布兰奇，你准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Blanche looked down at the desk and saw Hutton's clothes folded neatly in a pile.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇低头看向桌子，看到赫顿的衣服整齐地叠成一堆。

sentences.en: She picked up his clothes, walked out of the room, and then ran from the store, leaving Hutton to walk out in a butcher's apron.
sentences.zh: 她拿起他的衣服，走出房间，然后跑出了商店，留下赫顿穿着屠夫围裙走出来。

sentences.en: Blanche never returned to Kroger's.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇再也没有回到克罗格超市。

sentences.en: Things with Raymond became difficult after this.
sentences.zh: 此后，她和雷蒙德之间的事情变得困难起来。

sentences.en: Blanche turned to Reverend Moore for comfort, and three months later, she filed a $13.8 million lawsuit against Roger Hutton and Kroger's for sexual harassment on the job.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇向摩尔牧师寻求安慰，三个月后，她对罗杰·赫顿和克罗格超市提起了1380万美元的诉讼，指控其职场性骚扰。

sentences.en: Raymond paid her legal bills.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德支付了她的律师费。

sentences.en: Blanche claimed that this wasn't the first attack she had suffered.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇声称这并不是她遭受的第一次攻击。

sentences.en: She said Hutton often made suggestive comments, and had also made numerous attempts to fondle her and other female clerks.
sentences.zh: 她说赫顿经常发表暗示性的言论，还多次试图猥亵她和其他女店员。

sentences.en: On one occasion, he reached up her skirt and exposed himself.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他伸手进她的裙子并暴露了自己的下体。

sentences.en: Her lawsuit cited four counts of assault, three counts of inflicting emotional distress, and one count of invasion of privacy.
sentences.zh: 她的诉讼列举了四项袭击罪、三项造成精神伤害罪和一项侵犯隐私罪。

sentences.en: She sued for negligence, alleging that company officials were aware of Hutton's harassment as they had received numerous complaints from other female employees,
sentences.zh: 她起诉其疏忽职守，声称公司官员知道赫顿的骚扰行为，因为他们已经收到了许多其他女员工的投诉，

sentences.en: but they failed to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 但他们却对此置之不理。

sentences.en: Hutton was forced to resign.
sentences.zh: 赫顿被迫辞职。

sentences.en: Blanche saw a psychiatrist whose notes described a woman angry and resentful of men.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇看了一位精神科医生，医生的笔记描述她是一个对男人充满愤怒和怨恨的女人。

sentences.en: One note read, She could no longer stand the side of men.
sentences.zh: 其中一条笔记写道：她再也无法忍受男人。

sentences.en: Has resentment of men.
sentences.zh: 对男人有怨恨。

sentences.en: Needs to go out with good men to counter this.
sentences.zh: 需要和好男人约会来抵消这种情绪。

sentences.en: The psychiatrist was able to illustrate the huge impact the harassment had on her life.
sentences.zh: 精神科医生能够说明这种骚扰对她生活造成的巨大影响。

sentences.en: The lawsuit had worn Blanche down, and contributed heavily to her becoming depressed and suicidal.
sentences.zh: 这场诉讼让布兰奇心力交瘁，并极大地导致她变得抑郁并有了自杀倾向。

sentences.en: Another note from her psychiatrist read,
sentences.zh: 她精神科医生的另一条笔记写道：

sentences.en: Completely alienated and antagonistic toward men, and has not been able to maintain any meaningful social contacts with members of the opposite sex.
sentences.zh: 完全疏远并敌视男性，无法与异性保持任何有意义的社交联系。

sentences.en: Having a new romantic relationship with Reverend Dwight Moore was not the sort of thing Blanche wanted to be known, especially since it was a happy one.
sentences.zh: 与德怀特·摩尔牧师开始新的恋情并不是布兰奇想让人知道的事，尤其是因为这是一段幸福的恋情。

sentences.en: In order to win her lawsuit, she needed to maintain that she was suffering and unable to move on.
sentences.zh: 为了赢得诉讼，她需要坚持自己正遭受痛苦且无法走出阴影。

sentences.en: So as 1985 drew to a close, Blanche continued to keep her relationship with Reverend Moore a secret.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着1985年接近尾声，布兰奇继续对她与摩尔牧师的关系保密。

sentences.en: According to Reverend Moore's sister, he wasn't aware that Blanche was still romantically involved with Raymond Reed at the time.
sentences.zh: 据摩尔牧师的姐姐说，他当时并不知道布兰奇还在与雷蒙德·里德保持恋爱关系。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve 1985, Blanche was with Raymond Reed at his home in nearby Winston-Salem.
sentences.zh: 1985年除夕夜，布兰奇和雷蒙德·里德在他位于附近温斯顿-塞勒姆的家中。

sentences.en: Blanche made potato soup as the pair celebrated the new year.
sentences.zh: 两人庆祝新年时，布兰奇做了土豆汤。

sentences.en: The following day, Raymond woke up with terrible stomach pains.
sentences.zh: 第二天，雷蒙德醒来时感到胃部剧痛。

sentences.en: This soon turned into severe nausea, vomiting, and diarrhoea.
sentences.zh: 这很快演变成了严重的恶心、呕吐和腹泻。

sentences.en: Just as Raymond started to feel well again, the symptoms returned, and he was unable to go to work.
sentences.zh: 就在雷蒙德开始感觉好转时，症状又复发了，他无法去上班。

sentences.en: This continued on and off for the next few months, and during that time, Raymond took four weeks off work.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在接下来的几个月里断断续续地持续着，在此期间，雷蒙德请了四周的假。

sentences.en: Something he was not known to have ever done.
sentences.zh: 这是他以前从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: By April 1986, Raymond had gone completely downhill and ended up in hospital.
sentences.zh: 到1986年4月，雷蒙德的身体状况彻底恶化，最终住进了医院。

sentences.en: Doctors believed he was suffering from shingles.
sentences.zh: 医生认为他患的是带状疱疹。

sentences.en: Blanche, who was still sharing her time between Raymond and Reverend Moore, realised that Raymond's health was getting worse and he needed her care.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇当时还在雷蒙德和摩尔牧师之间周旋，她意识到雷蒙德的健康状况正在恶化，需要她的照顾。

sentences.en: She was, after all, experienced in nursing sick people.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，她在护理病人方面很有经验。

sentences.en: She had nursed her father, her mother-in-law, and her first husband as they lay on their deathbeds, so she was well equipped.
sentences.zh: 她曾护理过父亲、婆婆和第一任丈夫，看着他们躺在临终病床上，所以她很有经验。

sentences.en: The Reverend understood that Blanche had to go to the aid of Raymond and gave his blessing.
sentences.zh: 牧师理解布兰奇必须去帮助雷蒙德，并给予了她祝福。

sentences.en: She nursed Raymond through his illness, and he actually improved and was able to return to work.
sentences.zh: 她悉心照料雷蒙德度过了病情，他的情况确实有所好转，并能够重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: But the following month, Raymond got sick again.
sentences.zh: 但次月，雷蒙德又病倒了。

sentences.en: One night after he and Blanche ate dinner, he began experiencing nausea, vomiting, and diarrhoea.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他和布兰奇吃完晚饭后，开始出现恶心、呕吐和腹泻。

sentences.en: This time, he was so violently ill he was unable to recover.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他病得非常严重，无法康复。

sentences.en: He became severely dehydrated, and on May 30th 1986, he was once again admitted to the Wesley Long Hospital in Greensboro.
sentences.zh: 他严重脱水，并于1986年5月30日再次被送往格林斯伯勒的卫斯理·朗医院。

sentences.en: He was seen by Dr. Norman Garrett Jr., whose admission diagnosis was acute gastroenteritis.
sentences.zh: 他由诺曼·加勒特医生接诊，入院诊断为急性肠胃炎。

sentences.en: Blanche expected that Raymond would make a full recovery like before, but his symptoms snowballed, and Dr. Garrett revised his diagnosis to multiple systems failure.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇本以为雷蒙德会像以前一样完全康复，但他的症状像滚雪球一样恶化，加勒特医生将诊断修改为多系统衰竭。

sentences.en: Raymond got a skin rash.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德身上长了皮疹。

sentences.en: His blood tests revealed he had bone marrow damage and blood cell abnormalities.
sentences.zh: 血液检查显示他的骨髓受损，血细胞异常。

sentences.en: He was also suffering from progressive shortness of breath, respiratory failure, fast heartbeat,
sentences.zh: 他还患有进行性呼吸短促、呼吸衰竭、心跳过快、

sentences.en: low blood pressure, kidney malfunction and shutdown, and a numbness and tingling in his hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 低血压、肾功能障碍和衰竭，以及手脚麻木和刺痛感。

sentences.en: He had also gotten an infection, which meant he would require a circumcision.
sentences.zh: 他还感染了，这意味着他需要接受包皮环切手术。

sentences.en: But the doctors felt all of these issues were treatable.
sentences.zh: 但医生认为所有这些问题都是可以治疗的。

sentences.en: And they were proven right.
sentences.zh: 事实证明他们是对的。

sentences.en: Within five days, Raymond's condition stabilised, and Dr. Garrett said he should only need up to five more days in hospital, and then he would be right to go home.
sentences.zh: 五天内，雷蒙德的病情稳定了下来，加勒特医生说他只需要再住院五天，然后就可以回家了。

sentences.en: With Raymond improving and feeling like eating again,
sentences.zh: 随着雷蒙德好转并开始有胃口进食，

sentences.en: Blanche began making him home-cooked meals, including Jell-O and peanut butter milkshakes, so he wouldn't have to eat the hospital food.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇开始为他做家常饭菜，包括果冻和花生酱奶昔，这样他就不用吃医院的食物了。

sentences.en: After three days, as the hospital staff were expecting Raymond to be rapidly improving, they were all shocked to see his condition worsen again.
sentences.zh: 三天后，就在医护人员期待雷蒙德迅速康复时，他们都震惊地发现他的病情再次恶化。

sentences.en: His previous symptoms of nausea, vomiting, and diarrhoea returned so seriously that Dr. Garrett was unable to find a satisfactory diagnosis for Raymond's multi-system failures,
sentences.zh: 他之前恶心、呕吐和腹泻的症状严重复发，以至于加勒特医生无法为雷蒙德的多系统衰竭找到满意的诊断，

sentences.en: and his condition became life-threatening.
sentences.zh: 而且他的病情变得危及生命。

sentences.en: Raymond was transferred to the North Carolina Baptist Hospital in Winston-Salem.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德被转送至温斯顿-塞勒姆的北卡罗来纳州浸信会医院。

sentences.en: There, Raymond and Blanche were seen by Dr. Robert Hamilton, a specialist in internal medicine and nephrology.
sentences.zh: 在那里，雷蒙德和布兰奇由内科和肾脏科专家罗伯特·汉密尔顿医生接诊。

sentences.en: Dr. Hamilton noted that upon admission, Raymond had a raspy voice, severe swelling in his lower extremities, a rash over his lower extremities, anemia, low white blood cell count,
sentences.zh: 汉密尔顿医生指出，雷蒙德入院时声音嘶哑，下肢严重肿胀，下肢有皮疹，贫血，白细胞计数低，

sentences.en: white patches in his mouth, very poor bowel sounds, difficulty breathing, and signs of kidney failure.
sentences.zh: 口腔有白斑，肠鸣音极差，呼吸困难，并有肾衰竭迹象。

sentences.en: His condition deteriorated so seriously that it resulted in a cardiac arrest code-blue emergency.
sentences.zh: 他的病情恶化得非常严重，导致了心脏骤停，触发了蓝色代码紧急救援。

sentences.en: But doctors and nurses acted quickly, and Raymond was revived.
sentences.zh: 但医生和护士迅速采取行动，雷蒙德被抢救了过来。

sentences.en: Following resuscitation, he required mechanical ventilators, and over the days that followed, he became virtually paralysed.
sentences.zh: 复苏后，他需要机械通气，在接下来的几天里，他几乎瘫痪了。

sentences.en: Raymond was diagnosed with Guillain-Barre syndrome, also known as French polio at the time.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德被诊断出患有格林-巴利综合征，当时也被称为“法国小儿麻痹症”。

sentences.en: It's an autoimmune disease, where the body's immune system begins to attack the peripheral nervous system.
sentences.zh: 这是一种自身免疫性疾病，身体的免疫系统开始攻击周围神经系统。

sentences.en: It can be very difficult to diagnose in its early stages, which is why it was initially missed by doctors.
sentences.zh: 在早期阶段很难诊断，这就是为什么医生最初漏诊的原因。

sentences.en: Raymond improved slightly after a procedure called plasmapheresis, where they removed the blood from his body, separated the red blood cells from the plasma,
sentences.zh: 在接受了血浆置换术后，雷蒙德的情况略有改善，他们将血液从他体内抽出，将红细胞与血浆分离，

sentences.en: and returned the red blood cells back to his body.
sentences.zh: 然后将红细胞输回他体内。

sentences.en: He was kept in intensive care, and to make sure his body was handling the procedure, doctors kept up toxicology screening with blood and urine tests.
sentences.zh: 他被留在重症监护室，为了确保他的身体能承受这种手术，医生持续进行血液和尿液毒理学筛查。

sentences.en: Some of the blood test results returned showing he was progressing well, but the urine tests sat unopened.
sentences.zh: 一些血液检查结果显示他恢复得很好，但尿液样本却一直未被拆封。

sentences.en: Although still needing a respirator,
sentences.zh: 虽然仍需要呼吸机，

sentences.en: Raymond gradually recovered the use of his arms and legs, and was able to breathe on his own.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德逐渐恢复了手臂和腿部的活动能力，并能够自主呼吸。

sentences.en: The nurses thought Blanche was a saint for her constant bedside vigils, and her thoughtfulness to bring Raymond home-cooked food.
sentences.zh: 护士们认为布兰奇是个圣人，因为她始终守在床边，还贴心地给雷蒙德带来家常饭菜。

sentences.en: Things she knew he would be able to eat, like banana pudding, iced tea, frozen yogurt, milkshakes, and soups.
sentences.zh: 她知道他能吃的东西，比如香蕉布丁、冰茶、冷冻酸奶、奶昔和汤。

sentences.en: Two days later,
sentences.zh: 两天后，

sentences.en: Raymond fell once again into acute respiratory distress.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德再次陷入急性呼吸窘迫。

sentences.en: Stephen Reed,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·里德，

sentences.en: Raymond's son, was with Blanche at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德的儿子，当时和布兰奇在医院。

sentences.en: Raymond became so bloated, his skin was splitting, his eyeballs were bulging, and he was once again no longer able to breathe on his own.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德肿胀得非常厉害，皮肤开裂，眼球突出，再次无法自主呼吸。

sentences.en: He was fed by a feeding tube.
sentences.zh: 他靠喂食管进食。

sentences.en: By this time,
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，

sentences.en: Raymond was only able to communicate by nodding and squeezing people's hands.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德只能通过点头和握住别人的手来交流。

sentences.en: This was helpful when Blanche realised it was time for Raymond to sort out his will, something which he hadn't done yet.
sentences.zh: 当布兰奇意识到是时候让雷蒙德处理他的遗嘱时，这很有帮助，这是他还没做过的事情。

sentences.en: Blanche asked one of the nurses at the hospital if she wouldn't mind helping to take down some notes of what Raymond wanted.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇问医院的一位护士是否介意帮忙记录下雷蒙德的要求。

sentences.en: She then took these notes to a lawyer to draft up a will and power of attorney.
sentences.zh: 然后她带着这些笔记去找律师起草遗嘱和授权书。

sentences.en: The lawyer accompanied Blanche to the hospital to see Raymond and have the will confirmed and signed.
sentences.zh: 律师陪同布兰奇来到医院见雷蒙德，确认并签署遗嘱。

sentences.en: Raymond was unable to speak, but nodded his head and squeezed the nurse's hand who then gave the lawyer Raymond's answers.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德无法说话，但点了点头，握住了护士的手，护士随后将雷蒙德的回答转达给律师。

sentences.en: The lawyer was satisfied that Raymond understood everything, and he returned the next day when the will and the power of attorney were both signed.
sentences.zh: 律师确信雷蒙德明白了一切，第二天他回来时，遗嘱和授权书都已签署完毕。

sentences.en: Raymond's estate would be separated into thirds, between his two sons and his lifelong friend Blanche.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德的遗产将分为三份，分别由他的两个儿子和他的终身好友布兰奇继承。

sentences.en: Blanche also became the executor.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇还成为了遗嘱执行人。

sentences.en: Only days after this,
sentences.zh: 就在这几天之后，

sentences.en: October 7th, 1986,
Raymond died from complications of Guillain-Barré syndrome.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德死于格林-巴利综合征的并发症。

sentences.en: Blanche was devastated.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Just moments after Raymond was pronounced dead, she said to the doctors,
sentences.zh: 在雷蒙德被宣布死亡后不久，她对医生说：

sentences.en: Blanche felt lucky she had the Reverend Dwight Moore to help her through losing Raymond, whom she had been with for 25 years.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇感到幸运的是，她有德怀特·摩尔牧师帮助她度过失去雷蒙德的痛苦，她和雷蒙德在一起已经25年了。

sentences.en: The year following Raymond's death,
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德去世后的那一年，

sentences.en: Blanche was diagnosed with breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

sentences.en: She underwent radiation and chemotherapy and as a result, lost her hair and fingernails and the feeling in her lower legs.
sentences.zh: 她接受了放疗和化疗，结果导致头发和指甲脱落，小腿失去知觉。

sentences.en: She had to use a walking frame throughout her recovery.
sentences.zh: 她在康复期间不得不使用助行架。

sentences.en: But through it all,
sentences.zh: 但经历了这一切，

sentences.en: Reverend Moore was there, forever supporting her.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师一直陪伴在她身边，永远支持着她。

sentences.en: Blanche approached Raymond's sons shortly following her treatment and told them she was undergoing reconstructive breast surgery and she needed financial help.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇在治疗后不久联系了雷蒙德的儿子们，告诉他们她正在接受乳房重建手术，需要经济援助。

sentences.en: She requested they support her with some of their own inheritance, which they both agreed.
sentences.zh: 她请求他们用他们自己继承的部分遗产来支持她，两人都同意了。

sentences.en: Blanche and Reverend Moore went public with their relationship shortly after Raymond's death.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德去世后不久，布兰奇和摩尔牧师公开了他们的关系。

sentences.en: Also around this time,
sentences.zh: 同样是在这段时间，

sentences.en: Blanche's lawsuit against Krogus settled out of court and she received $275,000.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇针对克罗格斯的诉讼庭外和解，她获得了27.5万美元。

sentences.en: Blanche's relationship with Reverend Dwight Moore was moving faSt.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇与德怀特·摩尔牧师的关系进展神速。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before the Reverend was standing in front of Blanche with a diamond and ruby engagement ring.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，牧师就拿着一枚红宝石镶钻订婚戒指站在了布兰奇面前。

sentences.en: Blanche said yes.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇答应了。

sentences.en: They planned a small, intimate wedding just after Thanksgiving in 1988, which wouldn't be long after the one-year anniversary of Raymond's death.
sentences.zh: 他们计划在1988年感恩节后举行一场小型而私密的婚礼，那时距离雷蒙德去世一周年纪念日也没过多久。

sentences.en: Blanche had always been a devoted Christian woman and was looking forward to her future as a pastor's wife.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇一直是一位虔诚的基督徒，她很期待未来作为牧师夫人的生活。

sentences.en: Before their wedding, the Reverend decided it was time to explain to Blanche the reason why his first marriage had failed.
sentences.zh: 婚礼前，牧师觉得是时候向布兰奇解释他第一次婚姻失败的原因了。

sentences.en: He sat her down and confessed that he had strayed in his first marriage.
sentences.zh: 他让她坐下，坦白了自己在第一次婚姻中曾有过出轨行为。

sentences.en: He had a 16-year affair with one of his parishioners and his wife eventually found out.
sentences.zh: 他与自己的一位教区居民有过一段长达16年的婚外情，最终被妻子发现了。

sentences.en: Blanche burst into tears and ran from his home.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇泪如雨下，跑出了他的家。

sentences.en: She confided in a family friend and said she wasn't sure if her engagement could continue.
sentences.zh: 她向一位家庭朋友吐露心声，说她不确定这段订婚是否还能继续。

sentences.en: She was bothered by Reverend Moore's previous affair and she couldn't move on from it.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师之前的婚外情让她感到困扰，她无法释怀。

sentences.en: But with the help of mutual friends,
sentences.zh: 但在共同朋友的帮助下，

sentences.en: Blanche decided to try and make it work and the engagement went ahead.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇决定试着去经营这段关系，订婚得以继续。

sentences.en: Just prior to the wedding date,
sentences.zh: 就在婚礼日期临近时，

sentences.en: Reverend Moore became suddenly ill.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师突然病倒了。

sentences.en: He was vomiting, had stomach pains and was unable to perform his church duties.
sentences.zh: 他呕吐、胃痛，无法履行教会职责。

sentences.en: The Reverend was so sick, he and Blanche had to postpone their wedding.
sentences.zh: 牧师病得太重，他和布兰奇不得不推迟了婚礼。

sentences.en: Reverend Moore ended up in hospital and doctors were unable to work out what was wrong with him.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师最终住进了医院，医生无法查出他到底得了什么病。

sentences.en: He recovered, but shortly after, he was violently ill again.
sentences.zh: 他康复了，但没过多久，他又剧烈地病倒了。

sentences.en: He had two intestinal operations, after which he was well enough to get married.
sentences.zh: 他做了两次肠道手术，之后身体状况好转，足以举行婚礼。

sentences.en: On April 19th, 1989,
Blanche and Reverend Dwight Moore finally married.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇和德怀特·摩尔牧师终于结婚了。

sentences.en: There was a small gathering at his church, witnessed by just two fellow parishioners.
sentences.zh: 他们在他的教堂举行了一个小型聚会，只有两位教区居民见证。

sentences.en: Blanche wore a white-patterned dress and the pair were beaming according to one of the witnesses.
sentences.zh: 据其中一位见证人说，布兰奇穿着一件白色花纹的裙子，两人都笑逐颜开。

sentences.en: Immediately following their wedding, they spent a long weekend in New Jersey before returning home to spend a relaxing week working around the small home that Dwight had purchased
sentences.zh: 婚礼结束后，他们立即在新泽西州度过了一个长周末，然后回到家中，花了一周时间轻松地打理德怀特购买的小屋，

sentences.en: for he and Blanche to live in.
sentences.zh: 那是供他和布兰奇居住的地方。

sentences.en: Just five days into their marriage,
sentences.zh: 婚后仅仅五天，

sentences.en: Dwight was doing some work in the garden.
sentences.zh: 德怀特正在花园里干活。

sentences.en: He was spraying poison on some weeds which had become overgrown in their yard.
sentences.zh: 他正在给院子里疯长的杂草喷洒毒药。

sentences.en: Blanche brought her new husband a chicken sandwich, smiling from ear to ear as he happily worked on their new home.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇给新婚丈夫送去了一个鸡肉三明治，看着他在新家里快乐地忙碌，笑得合不拢嘴。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon,
sentences.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，

sentences.en: Dwight wasn't feeling well.
sentences.zh: 德怀特感到身体不适。

sentences.en: His stomach was playing up again and he started vomiting.
sentences.zh: 他的胃又开始闹腾，并开始呕吐。

sentences.en: Blanche cared for him, thinking it would subside.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇照顾着他，以为症状会消退。

sentences.en: But it didn't.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: It got worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 病情反而越来越严重。

sentences.en: She took her husband to the emergency room and he was admitted to Alamance County Hospital.
sentences.zh: 她把丈夫送到了急诊室，他被收治进了阿拉曼斯县医院。

sentences.en: When the Reverend's daughter,
sentences.zh: 当牧师的女儿，

sentences.en: Debbie, phoned the hospital,
sentences.zh: 黛比，打电话到医院时，

sentences.en: Blanche informed her that her father was merely undergoing tests.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇告诉她，她父亲只是在做检查。

sentences.en: There was nothing major and there was no need for her to attend.
sentences.zh: 没什么大碍，她不需要过来。

sentences.en: But this wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 但这并非事实。

sentences.en: The Reverend was gravely ill.
sentences.zh: 牧师病得很重。

sentences.en: So ill, he was soon transferred to another hospital, the North Carolina Baptist Hospital in Winston-Salem, where Raymond had once been.
sentences.zh: 病重到很快就被转院到了温斯顿-塞勒姆的北卡罗来纳浸信会医院，雷蒙德曾经也在那里住过。

sentences.en: Reverend Moore started to improve a little and Blanche rarely left his side.
sentences.zh: 摩尔牧师的病情开始有所好转，布兰奇几乎寸步不离。

sentences.en: When he was well enough to eat, she brought him food from home that he liked and good stomach.
sentences.zh: 当他身体好转能进食时，她从家里带来他喜欢的食物，让他补补胃。

sentences.en: The nurses thought she was the most thoughtful, caring woman.
sentences.zh: 护士们认为她是一位最体贴、最关怀备至的女性。

sentences.en: Before long,
sentences.zh: 没过多久，

sentences.en: Dwight became extremely ill again.
sentences.zh: 德怀特又变得病入膏肓。

sentences.en: He was transferred to intensive care at North Carolina Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill.
sentences.zh: 他被转入教堂山北卡罗来纳纪念医院的重症监护室。

sentences.en: His heart, liver and kidneys were failing and the doctors didn't think he was going to make it.
sentences.zh: 他的心脏、肝脏和肾脏都在衰竭，医生认为他挺不过去了。

sentences.en: His illness was baffling.
sentences.zh: 他的病情令人费解。

sentences.en: But when Blanche explained that the day Reverend Moore had become ill, he was spraying weed poison and then ate a chicken sandwich.
sentences.zh: 但当布兰奇解释说，摩尔牧师病倒的那天，他正在喷洒除草剂，然后吃了一个鸡肉三明治时，

sentences.en: The doctors immediately called for the hospital toxicologiSt.
sentences.zh: 医生立即叫来了医院的毒理学家。

sentences.en: They believed he may have had accidental herbicide poisoning.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他可能是意外摄入了除草剂中毒。

sentences.en: On May 13th, 1989, at 56 years of age,
Blanche was facing the possibility of having to say goodbye to her new husband of less than a month.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇面临着不得不与结婚不到一个月的新婚丈夫告别的可能。

sentences.en: That day, the doctors called the family in, including the Reverend's sister Nola and daughter Debbie.
sentences.zh: 那天，医生召集了家属，包括牧师的妹妹诺拉和女儿黛比。

sentences.en: Everyone gathered around as the doctor explained the results of the trace and toxic metals teSt.
sentences.zh: 大家聚在一起，医生解释了微量元素和有毒金属检测的结果。

sentences.en: With the look on the doctor's face, they thought it must be true.
